description: Use when you must profile an IP address in one call: ASN, AS name and country of its announced range, whether it is a current Tor exit node, and whether it lies in a public cloud range. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /ip/passport, $0.003 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. One public IP only (private and reserved addresses are refused before any charge); to check it together with a domain, CVE, package or software version in one call use check_infra. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.
